title: Merge PDF Files
description: Combine multiple PDFs into one file in the order you choose.
intro: Bring reports, forms, or scanned documents together in one tidy PDF. Arrange the files first; their pages are added in that order.
howTo: Choose two or more PDF files.
Use the arrows to set the file order.
Select Merge PDFs and download the combined document.

faqs.question: Can I change the order before merging?
faqs.answer: Yes. Move files up or down in the list before you merge. The output follows that order.

faqs.question: Are my files uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The PDFs are read and combined locally in this browser tab.

title: Split PDF by Page Range
description: Save a chosen range or set of pages as a separate PDF.
intro: Choose exactly which pages to keep, using single pages and ranges such as 1-3, 7. The selected pages are saved in their original order.
howTo: Choose a PDF and check its page count.
Enter pages like 1-3, 7, 9-10.
Select Extract pages and save the new PDF.

faqs.question: Which page range formats work?
faqs.answer: Enter page numbers separated by commas. A hyphen marks a continuous range, for example 1-3, 7, 9-10.

faqs.question: Can I create several separate files at once?
faqs.answer: This tool creates one PDF containing the ranges you select, in document order.

title: Extract PDF Pages
description: Pick individual pages and save them in a new PDF.
intro: Keep only the pages you need. Select page thumbnails or use the select all control; the extracted pages stay in their original order.
howTo: Choose a PDF.
Select the page thumbnails to keep.
Extract and download the smaller PDF.

faqs.question: Will the pages keep their original order?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pages are copied in the order they appear in the original PDF.

faqs.question: Can I extract one page?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select a single page and create a one-page PDF.

title: Delete PDF Pages
description: Remove selected pages and download the remaining PDF.
intro: Select pages to remove while keeping the rest of the document in order. At least one page must remain in the result.
howTo: Choose a PDF.
Select the page thumbnails to remove.
Review how many pages remain, then download.

faqs.question: Can I remove more than one page?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select any number of pages as long as at least one page remains.

faqs.question: Can I undo the selection?
faqs.answer: Use Clear selection to start again before processing.

title: Reorder PDF Pages
description: Change the page order with drag and drop or move controls.
intro: Arrange pages into a more useful order. Drag a page to move it, or use the arrow controls for precise keyboard-friendly reordering.
howTo: Choose a PDF and wait for page previews.
Drag pages, or use each card’s move buttons.
Save the reordered PDF.

faqs.question: Can I reorder pages on a phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the up and down controls on each page card; they work with touch and keyboard.

faqs.question: Does reordering change page content?
faqs.answer: No. The tool changes page order and keeps each page’s content.

title: Rotate PDF Pages
description: Rotate every page or selected pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
intro: Correct sideways or upside-down pages. Choose a rotation amount, then apply it to the whole document or only the selected pages.
howTo: Choose a PDF.
Select pages or leave the selection empty to rotate all.
Choose the angle and save the rotated PDF.

faqs.question: Can I rotate just one page?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select only that page before processing. With no pages selected, all pages are rotated.

faqs.question: Does rotation alter the content?
faqs.answer: Rotation changes the page’s orientation in the PDF; it does not rasterize the page.

title: Convert JPG to PDF
description: Turn one or more JPG images into a PDF document.
intro: Create a PDF from JPG or JPEG photos. Add multiple images, arrange them, and choose a page size that suits your document.
howTo: Choose one or more JPG or JPEG images.
Arrange the images and choose a page size.
Create and download your PDF.

faqs.question: Can I put several photos in one PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each image becomes a page, in the order shown.

faqs.question: Are the images uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Image conversion runs locally in your browser.

title: Convert PNG to PDF
description: Turn one or more PNG images into a PDF document.
intro: Put PNG artwork, screenshots, or scanned pages into a PDF. Each image becomes a page and can be moved into the order you want.
howTo: Choose one or more PNG images.
Arrange the images and choose a page size.
Create and download your PDF.

faqs.question: Can I convert multiple PNGs together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each image is placed on its own PDF page in the order shown.

faqs.question: Will transparent areas stay transparent?
faqs.answer: PDF pages have a white background, so transparent PNG areas appear white.

title: Convert PDF to JPG
description: Render selected PDF pages as downloadable JPG images.
intro: Turn PDF pages into JPG images for sharing or placing in another document. Choose specific pages or render the full file into a ZIP.
howTo: Choose a PDF and select pages or all pages.
Choose a rendering size.
Download the page images together as a ZIP.

faqs.question: Can I convert just a few pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter page numbers or ranges, for example 1-2, 5.

faqs.question: Does converting to JPG keep selectable text?
faqs.answer: No. JPGs are images of the pages; text is no longer selectable.

title: Convert PDF to PNG
description: Render selected PDF pages as downloadable PNG images.
intro: Create crisp PNG images from your PDF pages. Select a page range or convert the whole document into a convenient ZIP download.
howTo: Choose a PDF and select pages or all pages.
Choose a rendering size.
Download the page images together as a ZIP.

faqs.question: Can I convert just selected pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter page numbers or ranges before rendering.

faqs.question: Does PNG preserve PDF links or text?
faqs.answer: No. Each PNG is a flat image of one rendered page.

title: Compress PDF
description: Reduce PDF size by rendering pages as compressed images.
intro: This browser-based compressor rebuilds pages as JPEG images. It can make scanned or image-heavy files smaller, but text and vector content become images. The page shows the actual size change before you download.
howTo: Choose a PDF and review the rasterization note.
Select an image quality.
Compress, compare file sizes, and download if the result suits you.

faqs.question: Will the compressed PDF stay searchable?
faqs.answer: No. This method turns each page into an image, so selectable text, links, forms, and accessibility structure are not preserved.

faqs.question: Will every PDF get smaller?
faqs.answer: No. The result size depends on its content and your quality setting. Actual sizes and percentage change are measured after processing.

title: PDF Page Counter
description: Check the number of pages and file size in a PDF.
intro: Get a quick page count and file size from a PDF. The document is opened in your browser and no account is needed.
howTo: Choose a PDF.
Wait for the page count and file size to appear.
Start over to inspect another file.

faqs.question: Does counting pages change my PDF?
faqs.answer: No. This tool only reads basic document information.

faqs.question: Why can’t some PDFs be counted?
faqs.answer: Password-protected or malformed documents may not be readable by the browser PDF parser.

title: PDF Metadata Viewer
description: View available title, author, dates, and other PDF metadata.
intro: Inspect the document properties stored in a PDF, including title, author, creator, producer, dates, and page count. Empty metadata fields are not shown.
howTo: Choose a PDF.
Review the metadata found in the document.
Select another file to inspect its properties.

faqs.question: Why are some fields missing?
faqs.answer: PDF metadata is optional. This page only shows values that are stored in the file.

faqs.question: Does viewing metadata upload the PDF?
faqs.answer: No. The document is read locally in your browser.

title: Extract Text from PDF
description: Extract selectable text from a PDF and copy or save it.
intro: Copy text embedded in a PDF into a plain text file. Scanned pages without a text layer are not recognized because this tool does not include OCR.
howTo: Choose a text-based PDF.
Select Extract text.
Copy the text or download it as a .txt file.

faqs.question: Can it read scanned documents?
faqs.answer: Not unless the scan already contains a text layer. This tool does not perform OCR.

faqs.question: Why does extracted text look different?
faqs.answer: PDFs position text visually; line breaks and reading order can vary when text is extracted.

title: Add Page Numbers to PDF
description: Add a starting page number at the top or bottom of each page.
intro: Number every page in a PDF with a small, readable label. Choose the alignment and starting number before creating the updated document.
howTo: Choose a PDF.
Pick top or bottom, alignment, and starting number.
Add the numbers and download the PDF.

faqs.question: Can numbering start at a number other than one?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter the first number to use; subsequent pages count up from there.

faqs.question: Does this replace existing page numbers?
faqs.answer: No. New numbers are drawn over the existing page content.

title: Add a Text Watermark to PDF
description: Place a customizable text watermark on every PDF page.
intro: Add a text label to every page with controls for position, size, opacity, and angle. Preview the settings in the controls before saving.
howTo: Choose a PDF and enter watermark text.
Set position, size, opacity, and angle.
Apply the watermark and download the new PDF.

faqs.question: Can I change the watermark opacity?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the opacity control to make the text lighter or darker.

faqs.question: Can I remove an existing watermark?
faqs.answer: No. This tool adds text; it does not identify or remove existing marks.
